author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: So im just putting 100% of my programming time into the next version, TomCat VI, instead of trying to do another update of v5

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: Did a roman numeral for the 6 cuz its cooler

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: But also should be the last 'big' update, because the key thing with the next update is it being based around a routing type function instead of my traditional mess

author: Jacob [Fundraising Officer]
content: Bet

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content:
Itll essentially read every message, do a little bit of thinking/checking criteria, and then depending on which category it falls into, it runs that specific function.

So like, if someone says a "Tomcat, ___" command, itll see the "tomcat," prefix and then try to fit into their request as best it can. This is compared to version 5 where it would literally go through every function and see if each message fit into that category. if that makes sense.

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: instead of ~400 lines of code running every time a message is sent, maybe 50 or 60 run, which decide where it goes, and then maybe another 100

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: Its just a bit more efficient and a lot easier to follow

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: but the biggest thing is how it can grow from there

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: If I want to add more features, I can just write that new code, and then update the 'router' with the extra option. I don't need to worry about that much compatibility, or it getting to slow or whatever. It only runs what is needed and can be very easily built upon as time goes on, which is why i say this is the last 'big' update. I'll keep adding features but I really won't need to rewrite it all ideally. Only small bugfixes and what not

author: Austin B [Records Director]
content: Another thing im excited for is NLP (Natural language processing), so it can still run commands when y'all make typos or forget the command or whatever
